note: Family-owned campground on the west shore of Trout Lake near Bovey and Grand Rapids. Mostly a seasonal RV community; a limited block of nightly and weekly RV sites on the lake. Sand swimming beach, dock, sauna, kayak and fishing-boat rentals. --Claude
summary: Operator + Campspot read: a mostly seasonal park (seasonal sites full, waiting list) with a limited nightly/weekly lakefront RV type at $54.50 a night (30/50-amp + water) on every date read, May-September 2027. DROP CANDIDATE: over the $50 price gate with no gateway within 40 km and no Good Sam park, on top of the mostly-seasonal profile.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): the only RV type sold by the night, 'Daily/Weekly In & Out (Lakefront)', is '$54.50 night' on Campspot for Tuesday 2027-05-18, Tuesday 2027-06-15, Saturday 2027-07-10 and Tuesday 2027-09-14. Even with Campspot's ~3% booking fee taken out, the site charge is about $52.90, over US$50. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Voyageurs NP 136 km); not a Good Sam park (not in the GS directory cache); no operator-posted member discount ('Deals Available' banner on Campspot, no deal named).

DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay): operator: 'We are primarily a seasonal RV community, with returning families who enjoy spending the entire summer on the lake. A limited number of sites are available for nightly and weekly stays throughout the season.'; 'Seasonal sites are currently full and operating with a waiting list.' Campspot lists 9 nightly locations. Mostly seasonal; with the price over the gate this falls under 'on the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop'. Google 4.6 (100) from the brief; Campspot 13 verified ratings, 4.8.

Waterfront (if kept): the operator/Campspot 'lakefront' wording cannot carry the value. On imagery (winter) the campground is a narrow strip between the lake and County Rd 10; the camper rows on the south lawn are about 40-50 m from the shore over open grass, but the nightly sites were not placed or numbered, so a keep of `lakefront` is not earned; `lakeview` at most, pending the drop decision.
Pin 47.24655,-93.38450 is at the office/parking lot by the entrance; Google's place 47.24576,-93.38476 is ~90 m south: OK.
Phone 218-301-7171 and website https://www.troutlakecampground.com/ match the operator page.
